atDirectives.name: @tailwind

atDirectives.name: @apply

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Define em qual camada do Tailwind CSS (base, components, utilities) devem ser incluídas suas regras personalizadas

atDirectives.name: @variants

atDirectives.name: @responsive
atDirectives.description: Gera estilos responsivos para diferentes tamanhos de tela

atDirectives.name: @screen
